blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A defense witness on Thursday showed a photo of Atty. Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, buying shoes in Malaysia for a youth basketball team in early 2025. It was the prosecution’s expert witness, Atty. Alexander Cabrera, who flagged the P256,882 purchase at a Nike store in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. To explain the purchase, the defense called Chadrin Parian of Las Piñas City, one of the parents of a player in Elite Philippines, the youth basketball team where Carpio serves as a manager and “co-parent.” “We went to Malaysia to compete because the kids had a […]...
